name: fir_saathi_auth_profiles
query: create table if not exists public.fir_saathi_profiles (id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, email text not null, display_name text, role text not null default 'citizen' check (role in ('citizen', 'constable')), created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); alter table public.fir_saathi_profiles enable row level security; create policy "profiles_select_own" on public.fir_saathi_profiles for select to authenticated using (id = auth.uid()); create or replace function public.handle_new_fir_saathi_user() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ begin insert into public.fir_saathi_profiles (id, email, display_name, role) values (new.id, coalesce(new.email, ''), coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name', split_part(coalesce(new.email, ''), '@', 1)), 'citizen') on conflict (id) do update set email = excluded.email, display_name = coalesce(excluded.display_name, public.fir_saathi_profiles.display_name), updated_at = now(); return new; end; $$; revoke execute on function public.handle_new_fir_saathi_user() from public, anon, authenticated; drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created_fir_saathi on auth.users; create trigger on_auth_user_created_fir_saathi after insert on auth.users for each row execute procedure public.handle_new_fir_saathi_user();
